notes.title: Version 1.7 (Controller Update)
notes.content:
Hi MechaGore Fans :) 

- Contoller api has been changed.
- Dual Shock 4 controller support has been added.
- Added new checkpoint to first level to prevent the Not to watch animation if you die in that level
- Various bug fixes.

Thank You 
Imaginite Games Studio
